COMMAND_HELPS.language: language [lang] | Set language, cn for Chinese, en for English.
COMMAND_HELPS.append: append [appl] at [dir] | Append new application shortcut.
COMMAND_HELPS.list: list | List all applications with established shortcuts and routes.
COMMAND_HELPS.jump: jump [appl] | Open explorer page of the application.
COMMAND_HELPS.check: check | Check if vital files are lost.

ALL_COMMANDS_FORMATTED: These are usable commands and input formats:
